cohort: 6535 live births occurring at a secondary health center between March 2009 and December 2015, involving mothers with a mean age of 26.7 years (range 15-47 years).
finding: The primary caesarean section rates observed in this secondary health center were very low.
mod_finding: During the study period, the mean primary caesarean section rate was 5.7% and the mean repeat caesarean section rate was 14.8%, with the primary CS rate decreasing from 8.8% in 2009 to 4.3% in 2015.
